### Step 3: Calculate Total Time After Hitting an Object

Since the question asks for the **total time the ball traveled after hitting an object**, and the ball continues moving after each collision, the total time includes all intervals **after the first hit** until the end of the video.

This is a **telescoping sum** — the sum of all intervals between hits equals the total time from the **first hit** to the **end of the video**.

$$
\text{Total time after hitting an object} = \text{End time} - \text{First hit time}
$$

$$
= 15.9 - 1.4 = 14.5 \text{ seconds}
$$

$$
\boxed{14.5}
